pipeline_params.description: Sqwish Router jointly selects among 16 model-budget actions over nine models. A 10-member ensemble predicts per-action quality from task features and full model fingerprints, then applies a cost-aware utility rule with an uncertainty penalty. A separately trained low-success classifier, fitted only on Sqwish's offline synthetic generation corpus and no RouterArena answers, model outcomes, scores or labels, diverts predicted-unsolved tasks to the cheap backup arm gpt-oss-20b when that arm is admissible. The same frozen selector, diversion rule and admissibility mask are applied to the full and robustness splits. Budget is a first-class routing action implemented through an ordinal generation-control lever covering reasoning effort, verbosity, answer style and output cap; its full cost is captured by the reported token usage. No RouterArena answers, model outcomes, scores or labels were used to fit or tune the router.
